name: Fuzzball Web Control
description: Let your paired local Fuzzball assistant inspect and activate visible controls on sites you allow.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src ws://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
